problem.paragraph: Let $$f$$ and $$g$$ be functions defined by the rules

list.item: The sum $$s$$ , the difference $$d$$ , the product $$p$$ , and the quotient $$q$$ of $$f$$ and $$g$$ .
The composite functions $$f \circ g$$ and $$g \circ f$$ .

solution.paragraph: $$\begin{array}{lll} {s(x)} & = & {f(x) + g(x) = \sqrt{x} + 1 + \frac{x}{1 + x}} \\ {d(x)} & = & {f(x) - g(x) = \sqrt{x} + 1 - \frac{x}{1 + x}} \\ {p(x)} & = & {f(x)g(x) = (\sqrt{x} + 1) \cdot \frac{x}{1 + x} = \frac{x(\sqrt{x} + 1)}{1 + x}} \\ {q(x)} & = & {\frac{f(x)}{g(x)} = \frac{\sqrt{x} + 1}{\frac{x}{1 + x}} = \frac{(\sqrt{x} + 1)(1 + x)}{x}} \end{array}$$
